answer.summary: Adding GetArchiveStorage(ctx context.Context) (tracestore.Reader, tracestore.Writer, error) to the jaegerstorage.Extension interface (defined in cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerstorage/extension.go) requires changes to 7 files: (1) the interface definition and its concrete implementation storageExt, (2) the primary consumer in jaegerquery/server.go which currently builds archive reader/writer manually, and (3) four test files containing mock/fake implementations that satisfy the interface via compile-time checks (jaegerquery/server_test.go, storageexporter/exporter_test.go, remotestorage/server_test.go, storagecleaner/extension_test.go). The interface is internal to the jaeger repository and not directly imported by OTel Collector contrib or Tempo - those projects use Jaeger as an OTel Collector component running in the same binary, so cross-repo impact is limited to version bumps of the jaeger module dependency.
answer.breaking_change_impact: This is a breaking change to the Extension interface in the jaegerstorage package. All types asserting interface compliance via `var _ jaegerstorage.Extension = (*Type)(nil)` will fail to compile. Four test mock/fake implementations must be updated. The storageExt production implementation must add the new method. The jaegerquery server can be refactored to use the new method instead of manually constructing archive Reader/Writer from factories.
